origins.base layer: Essential packages of the pinned Debian trixie-slim base (glibc, util-linux, ncurses, acl, zlib, perl-base), identical to the agent image's base-layer group in scan/baseline/timelike-agent.json, whose reasoning applies. Debian publishes no fixed package in trixie or trixie-security (Grype: wont-fix or not-fixed), so no fix is available. Unlike the agent image, the vanilla image keeps Debian's 11 setuid/setgid binaries (mount, umount, su, passwd, chfn, chsh, gpasswd, newgrp, chage, expiry, unix_chkpwd), deliberately: it is the unmodified baseline timelike is compared against. The local privilege-escalation findings therefore rely on no-new-privileges, not on the binaries' absence: In the bench, every task container runs as uid 1000 with --network none, --cap-drop ALL and no-new-privileges (bench/benchlib/docker.py), and bench/run.sh refuses a run with any key-shaped variable in the driver, either image's ENV or a task container. The rest are memory or resource bugs in library calls the bench's tasks do not reach with hostile input.
origins.git: Pulled in by git (libcurl3t64-gnutls, libexpat1, perl, libperl5.40, perl-modules-5.40), identical to the agent image's git group, whose reasoning applies. The vanilla image's purpose is 'Debian + git'. No fixed package in trixie or trixie-security. In the bench, task containers have no network at all (--network none), so no libcurl transfer happens, and they hold no credentials. In the bench, every task container runs as uid 1000 with --network none, --cap-drop ALL and no-new-privileges (bench/benchlib/docker.py), and bench/run.sh refuses a run with any key-shaped variable in the driver, either image's ENV or a task container.

findings.reason: Use-after-free that needs CURLOPT_STREAM_DEPENDS followed by curl_easy_reset. git's http transport never sets HTTP/2 stream dependencies. Bench context: vanilla task containers run with --network none and hold no credentials, so no transfer occurs. Re-review if a bench task container is ever given a network or credentials (for example live runs), and at feature 12.

Digest Authorization header carried to a second origin on a reused handle. The agent holds no credentials in slice 0 (P4): no credential helper, GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0, empty askpass, so no Authorization header exists to leak. Re-review when Adele (feature 12) brokers credentials. Bench context: vanilla task containers run with --network none and hold no credentials, so no transfer occurs. Re-review if a bench task container is ever given a network or credentials (for example live runs), and at feature 12.

Use-after-free in HTTP/2 server push with shared connections. Server push needs a push callback (CURLMOPT_PUSHFUNCTION), which git's http transport does not set. Bench context: vanilla task containers run with --network none and hold no credentials, so no transfer occurs. Re-review if a bench task container is ever given a network or credentials (for example live runs), and at feature 12.

Negotiate (SPNEGO) connection reuse after an empty-credential request. The image has no Kerberos credentials and sets no http.emptyAuth, and the agent holds no credentials at all (P4), so there is no authenticated connection for another request to ride on. Re-review when Adele (feature 12) brokers credentials. Bench context: vanilla task containers run with --network none and hold no credentials, so no transfer occurs.
